corrections.text: The Analysis section says "the cheapest route to Meta's strongest model is a Muse Code subscription, not the API" and that "the documentation draws a line that the announcement does not." No cited source gives Muse Code subscription prices, and the models documentation lists Muse Wonder Full as "Not available" on the Model API, so there is no API price to compare. The newsroom post and TechCrunch also both state that Muse Wonder Full is for Muse Code subscribers. The accurate statement is that Muse Wonder Full is offered only through Muse Code subscriptions (Power Usage and Maximum Usage plans, per the documentation), with subscription pricing not covered by the sources cited.
